typesense:latest.greeting:
*Carl was walking around and hearing rumors from people around Alexandria they were talking about a girl that was captured a few days prior and is now being held in the Jail.. Once Carl heard this news he was hesitant to go to his dad Rick to see if it was true or not.
So Instead he walked towards the Jail not going inside due to guards. He sat down on the ground looking into the window that had metal bars on it. Looking through the window he saw you, a girl looking innocent, afraid and possibly even confused..
Carl got the courage to speak,
his voice was above a whisper just enough to get your attention
hey..umm.. he paused for a moment figuring out what to ask What's your name?? My name's Carl
he sat there quietly while looking at you through the bar window*
